method: Manual read-only source inspection;hashes/conclusions only,no native compilation/execution;tests never invoke/read upstream.
conclusions: Existing ruler gestures now follow inspected Ruler left-single-click/nontracking admission and VCL StartTracking replacement/key-input priority: one ruler owner and initiating pointer, Escape cancellation, Return acceptance at the last painted coordinate, all other tracking keys consumed before widget/document dispatch. Cancelled gestures do not commit; accepted termination releases listeners and ownership before one application callback. Browser handle/ruler teardown and window blur discard transient DOM callbacks without claiming identical native disposal flags. Existing coordinate conversion, snapping, ticks, guides, page/paragraph/tab callbacks and model undo remain owned by their previous layers. Owned boundary/handle/actual Writer tests and rebuilt desktop/mobile cases cover cancellation, stale release, accepted history and later input only. Complete native hit testing, double-click dialogs, modifier snapping, deletion, mouse capture, platform/LOK/input and full ruler/Writer/native parity remain unverified. Intentional save/open/recovery exceptions are preserved.
